item.title: Protesters torch Communist Party HQ in Cuba as video appears to capture gunfire
item.summary: Dramatic footage appears to show protester on the ground after alleged gunfire as crowds attack Communist Party building in Cuba, chanting 'Freedom!' amid crisis.

item.title: Ex-jihadist warns of predatory recruitment after ISIS-inspired bomb plot in New York City
item.summary: After a New York terror plot, a former jihadist turned counterterrorism expert reveals how ISIS-inspired recruiters target vulnerable American teens online.

item.title: Bill Maher presses Gov Josh Shapiro on Iran war, asks if 'you would still do nothing?'
item.summary: Bill Maher challenged Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro on Iran policy during a "Real Time" debate about nuclear weapons and Middle East military involvement.

item.title: Iran holds world energy hostage with 'nightmare' Strait of Hormuz sea mines, former CENTCOM official warns
item.summary: Iran's sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz threaten the global oil supply as President Donald Trump orders strikes on key Iranian island.

item.title: WNBA faces critical deadline as ongoing collective bargaining talks threaten to disrupt schedule, commish says
item.summary: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert and union Executive Director Terri Carmichael Jackson reported progress in contract talks but cautioned a deadline needs to be reached soon.

item.title: Motörhead guitarist Phil Campbell dead at 64
item.summary: Phil Campbell, Motörhead's longest-serving guitarist who helped define the legendary metal band's iconic sound for over three decades, has died at age 64.

item.title: Some Iranian soccer players granted asylum by Australia chose to return home, local official says
item.summary: Three Iranian women's soccer players granted asylum in Australia are returning to Iran despite threats, according to former player Tina Kordrostami, who says families face intimidation.

item.title: Trump-backed Potomac sewage cleanup complete after massive spill ahead of summer America250 celebrations
item.summary: Potomac River sewage spill repairs have been completed after President Donald Trump approved a federal disaster declaration allowing FEMA assistance.

item.title: ‘Yellowstone’ star Luke Grimes targeted by Montana locals as move from LA sparks small-town fury
item.summary: "Yellowstone's" Luke Grimes explains why he left Hollywood for Montana with wife Bianca Rodrigues despite facing unexpected local backlash from residents.

item.title: Players Championship delays gate opening amid manhunt for double murder suspect near golf course
item.summary: A dramatic manhunt for accused double murder suspect Christian Barrios led police through TPC Sawgrass before his capture Saturday morning, delaying The Players Championship.
